scope: All reachable physical directories from /workspace including directory-symlink targets scanned once by device/inode. Git metadata stores are explicit metadata exclusions; candidate roots independently read through Git. Ordinary files are not read by traversal; only Git config/pointer bytes are hashed and remote identities sanitized.
limitations: Read-only filesystem and Git metadata discovery; configuration was not read, saved, applied, or published.
All reachable physical directories and aliases were scanned without name-based pruning, apart from explicitly recorded Git metadata stores.
No active application or compiler was present; this is a bounded discovery observation, not an atomic filesystem snapshot. No traversal error was silently discarded.
Previously classified generated roots require equality of every fresh recorded Git metadata field, including sanitized remotes, configuration and linked-worktree pointer hashes.

The seven added roots are associated with exact original private warm/cold fixture pointers and the retained failed trace result fixture path. This does not establish test success, runtime cleanup, lease release, or deletion.
Live directory aliases were scanned or inode-deduplicated. Previously classified dangling aliases retain exact path, raw target, canonical target, kind and owner identity.
No network, archive-content verification, remote reproducibility or fresh-task restoration was attempted.
Private receipts preserve exact fixture paths with mode0600 inside a mode0700 directory. The public summary contains only selected checkout identity, aggregate counts and receipt hashes.
